summary: Add workflow_dispatch to deploy.yml (manual deploy escape hatch, optional SHA input)

resolution.note: Added workflow_dispatch trigger with optional 'sha' input; checkout and deploy.sh now use ${{ github.event.inputs.sha || github.sha }} so push deploys the pushed commit and a manual dispatch deploys the chosen SHA (or ref HEAD). Gives a manual deploy path for outages where the push event is lost. YAML validated.
